selected.selection_rule: maximum 80-image validation global IoU, never test performance

protocol.task: RGB-only flooded-road segmentation with fixed SEG prefix
protocol.selection: Official train: all 162 positives + SHA256-ordered 138 negatives; official val: 30 positives + 50 negatives; official test: all 448 images. Fixed before inference.
protocol.checkpoint_selection: Best validation global IoU among six scheduled states and one late average. Test never selects.
protocol.training_sampling: 50% positive, 50% negative, replacement; shared seed gives same sample/augmentation sequence for head and first LoRA arm
protocol.scope: Follow-up exploratory experiment on an already inspected 448-image test set. Frozen original train/val/test IDs, canonical RGB/labels, threshold, architecture and image encoders. No LoRA or added module in these matched arms.

loss_formula.long_bce_lovasz: BCE + binary Lovasz hinge, valid pixels, per image

protocol.averaging: Uniform average of training states at steps 3200,4000,4800. Compare to best single state using validation IoU only; identical treatment for both arms.
protocol.test_access: After all scheduled training (or deadline stop), each selected model is evaluated once on all 448 test images. Do not branch on test metrics.

night.loss_tests: perfect, opposite, all-negative, all-positive, all-ignore and gradients passed

old.selection_note: Positive cases at 20th,50th,80th percentiles of head-control IoU; illustrative only. Deployment checkpoint picked by validation IoU.
